spanish: y la mesa y todos sus utensilios, y la menorá y sus utensilios, y altar del incienso,

findings.issue: Common noun left as the untranslated lemma menorá; a Spanish common noun is required.
Definite construct chain (altar of the incense) is rendered with a bare head, so the licensed definiteness is omitted.

notes: Conjunctions, la mesa, todos sus utensilios, and the 3fs sus on the second utensilios match the tokens.
